methods.producer_kind: Actual inline Python commands and functions.exec orchestration in the task; no standalone metadata/graph producer file existed. This summary is a local synthesis, not a substitute for raw evidence.

inventory.capture: Parsed JSON list was held in orchestration memory, then split into ten inventory-part JSON files to respect the128KiB hook input ceiling. Content was not re-queried.

methods.pypi: Version-specific official HTTPS PyPI JSON metadata queries in a ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=4); records retain source_url, query time, full response SHA256, Requires-Python/Requires-Dist and provider vulnerability IDs. Complete network response bodies were not retained; metadata fields were selected without package installation.
methods.dependency_graph: Normalize names with packaging.utils.canonicalize_name; start from exact native installed versions/Requires-Dist, replace the23 selected candidate versions and their Requires-Dist. Evaluate each PEP508 marker with extra empty, Linux/Python3.14.7 and aarch64 then x86_64. Every active requirement must have an installed/selected version satisfying its specifier; Requires-Python checked against3.14.7.

amd64_marker_inputs.source: Previous actual CI fac92ea release images/langflow-inventory.json, already selected in prior packet; existing architecture-specific markers were evaluated for Linux/x86_64 rather than inventing native installation.

methods.extras_limitation: The graph checks default-active requirements. Historical optional extras and full pip resolver behavior remain actual CI pip-check/build responsibility; litellm proxy-runtime and other unselected extras are not enabled.
